Core mechanic

The Blood of Dawnwalker Time Limit Explained

Mechanic confirmed; exact budget pending

Official material says time advances when you commit to quests, rather than simply passing while you explore.

How time advances

The official site frames Coen’s mission around limited time and says that taking on quests moves time forward.

Exploration and planning

Because the system is tied to choices, the practical question is likely which quests consume time—not a real-time countdown while reading menus.

What remains unknown

The final game’s exact day budget, quest costs and failure states are not asserted here. Those need release-build evidence.

This pre-release page separates official facts from unresolved questions. It will not invent hands-on results before the game is available.
